precepts.text: He likens his judgment unto a ring. A ring is like a circle: there is no slackness of the last, and no swiftness of the first. His judgments on the earth are a continual event that reoccurs over and over. That is why Paul said comfort yourselves through what is written in the testimonies of the past, because what you are living is a reoccurring event.
precepts.point: In order to deal with these reoccurring events, we must read the history and testimonies of our ancestors from the past, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

note.label: Agree Together | Bound Not Bondage

precepts.why:
Solomon said, “The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.” Paul says the same thing in different words: “For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning”. Our learning today. There are no new incidents on this earth; everything that was done in the past is reoccurring.

Ezra shows it with a ring: “And he said unto me, I will liken my judgment unto a ring”. A ring is like a circle. “like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first”. Slackness means slow: there is no slowness of the last judgments and no swiftness of the first. His judgments on the earth are a continual event that reoccurs over and over; it is the same thing.

That is why Paul said to comfort ourselves through what is written in the testimonies of the past: what we are living is a reoccurring event. To deal with these reoccurring events we must read the history and testimonies of our ancestors, “that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.”

We see it now. Nebuchadnezzar set up a golden image and gathered the rulers to its dedication, setting up a one world religion; today pastors gather to pray over and dedicate a towering gold statue of Donald Trump. What we read in Daniel 3 is coming to pass again, because the judgments go around like a ring.

precepts.text: He said unto me, I will liken my judgment unto a ring. The curse comes right back around: Assyria, Babylon, Persia, Greece, Rome, and America present day. It keeps happening because we are the people of God. But this is the last time.

note.label: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.why:
Servants ruling over us happened with Assyria, Babylon, Persia, Greece, Rome, and America present day. The Lord explains it to Ezra: “And he said unto me, I will liken my judgment unto a ring”.

A ring is a circular motion. You see this curse? It comes right back around, empire after empire, and it keeps happening because we are the people of God. But this is the last time. All praise to the Most High.

So the slavery in America where Colossians 3:22 was used against us is one more turn of that ring of judgment on Israel. It was not the Lord making the white man our rightful master; it was his judgment coming back around on his own people, and it ends with this last time.

precepts.point: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the Lord. Although it happened with Nebuchadnezzar, God said it is going to happen again in the latter days. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.

note.label: The Madmen Of China And Their Hatred For Black People

precepts.why:
Jeremiah ends the judgment of Moab with “Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the Lord. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.” Although it happened with Nebuchadnezzar, God said it is going to happen again in the latter days. Ezra shows how God's judgment runs: “I will liken my judgment unto a ring: like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first.”

There is no slackness of the last plagues and judgments, and no swiftness of the first. It is a steady flow, a steady flow of judgment upon all nations. What came on Moab in the days of Nebuchadnezzar comes round again on Moab today, and the fear, the pit and the snare will find them even in the hidden bunker city under Beijing.

So are we promoting harm to the Chinese? No. Some of you work for them, some of you go to school with them. Fine, that's fine. Our job is to tell you what God says is going to happen to these nations: not just the Chinese, but all nations. The judgment is God's, it comes in its time, and it comes on every nation.

precepts.text: Like as thou canst do none of these things that I have spoken of, even so canst thou not find out my judgment, or in the end the love that I have promised unto my people. Meaning it is unimaginable. We think we can imagine it, but we cannot.
precepts.point: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge: in the Father and in Christ are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

note.label: Deceived by Enticing Words: Colossians 2

precepts.why:
Paul wrote, “Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.” Ezra was told the same: “Like as thou canst do none of these things that I have spoken of, even so canst thou not find out my judgment, or in the end the love that I have promised unto my people.”

Even so canst thou not find out my judgment, what the Lord is going to do, nor the love He has promised to His people in the end. It is unimaginable. We think we can imagine it, but we cannot. Men can create beautiful things, but nothing like what God has prepared.

That is part of what it means that in Christ “are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.” The things God has prepared for His people are hidden from the heart of man, and only revealed by His Spirit.

precepts.text: I will liken my judgment unto a ring: like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first. God shall be known in his judgments: when we sin and find ourselves back in captivity and prison houses, his judgment stands, and his prophecies are fulfilled. Take heed and fear God.

note.label: Called to Magnify the Law: Lord Increase Our Faith

precepts.why:
The Lord told Ezra, “I will liken my judgment unto a ring: like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first.” God's judgment goes round like a ring, a wheel. It comes around without fail, the last no slower than the first.

The scriptures say God shall be known in his judgments. So when Deuteronomy says that when we sin we will find ourselves back in captivity, in slavery and in prison houses, and we look around and see those conditions, his judgment stands. It is sure, and his prophecies are fulfilled. That is how we show that God is here: so take heed and fear God.

That is the frame for Psalms 94:20: “Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?” The 13th Amendment abolished slavery except as punishment for crime. Within fifteen years the Southern states were imprisoning black Americans at ten times the rate of whites; they made loitering and vagrancy felonies and leased the convicts out for forced labor. Today prison labor makes billions while inmates earn cents an hour. They framed mischief by a law and misled us with democracy and freedom. Slavery did not end; it evolved.

A former warden testified that a young defendant should get life without parole instead of death because the prison could use him: he is young, he is healthy, we need that sweat equity. That is the Willie Lynch letter: beat him within an inch of his life but don't kill him, because it is not good for economics.

The throne of iniquity has no fellowship with Christ: not their holidays, not their man-made religions, and no, the president is not God. Some people do need to be locked up if they rob and steal. But the judgment keeps turning like a ring, and what we institute is keeping God's commandments, so that you stay far from all of that.

note.label: From Exile & Tribulation to Promise

precepts.why:
“And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.” Why is iniquity going to abound? Because of the false prophets: the false Christians and these foolish Abrahamic religions teaching lie after lie. They glorify sin; sin is being glorified. And the love of many waxing cold means we are going to start to hate one another.

Ezra was told the same thing: “But iniquity shall be increased above that which now thou seest, or that thou hast heard long ago.” The angel was telling Ezra that iniquity would go way beyond anything he had known or seen.

And look at it now. Men are cutting their privates off and having a vagina cut in there. That was unheard of. Women are getting penises sewn on. You cannot make this stuff up. Magic Johnson's son says he is only attracted to straight men; if he is attracted to you, he is not straight.

That is iniquity increased above anything heard of long ago, exactly as the angel said. So repent. “But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved”: we have to endure the hardships, the tribulation and the persecution Christ said would come, and not let our love wax cold.

note.label: The Real Reason Iran Was Attacked

precepts.why:
Christ said the sun would be darkened and the stars would fall from heaven before the sign of the Son of man appears. Ezra shows the same end, and it goes into the land of Israel and those who call themselves Jews and are not being destroyed.

“The days shall come, that they which dwell upon earth shall be taken in a great number”. That is the third woe: billions of people are going to die. “And the way of truth shall be hidden”: who the Israelites are, who the people of that land are, is hidden. “And the land shall be barren of faith. But iniquity shall be increased above that which now thou seest, or that thou hast heard long ago.” You see how wicked this world is getting; that was prophesied.

“And the land, that thou seest now to have root, shalt thou see wasted suddenly.” The land that has root now is the land of Israel, and it will be destroyed suddenly by the Persians and the Arabs. That goes back to the destruction at noonday. Wasted is the word Isaiah uses: “I have created the waster to destroy.” Seeing the land wasted means nuclear bombs.

“But if the most High grant thee to live, thou shalt see after the third trumpet”: in Revelation the third trump is nuclear war. “That the sun shall suddenly shine again in the night”: a nuclear bomb going off at night looks like the sun shining. That is what the prophet saw. “And the moon thrice in the day”: three bombs going off in the day, at Ekron, Ashdod and Ashkelon. “And blood shall drop out of wood”.

That is why Iran was attacked: they are trying to stop prophecy, or slow it down. But God's counsel shall stand. Iran will develop nuclear warheads, the Arabs will unite, and they will be brought down in the valley of Jehoshaphat. The day of the Lord will not come on us as a thief, because we are watching the signs.

precepts.text: The earth in its youth brought forth greater stature, and each generation since is less than the one before.
precepts.point: They came to the brook of Eshcol and cut down a branch with one cluster of grapes, and bare it between two upon a staff. The cluster was so great it took two men to carry it, for the earth was younger then and brought forth greater stature in its fruit and its men.

note.label: Numbers 13: The Spies Search the Land

precepts.why:
At the brook of Eshcol the spies “cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff.” One cluster of grapes took two men to carry it. The earth was younger then and brought forth greater stature in its fruit and its men, the children of Anak among them.

Esdras asks the earth why those she brings forth now are “like those that were before, but less of stature”, and she answers: “They that be born in the the strength of youth are of one fashion, and they that are born in the time of age, when the womb faileth, are otherwise.” Then: “Consider thou therefore also, how that ye are less of stature than those that were before you. And so are they that come after you less than ye, as the creatures which now begin to be old, and have passed over the strength of youth.”

The earth in its youth brought forth greater stature, and each generation since is less than the one before. That is why the fruit of the land in the time of the firstripe grapes was of a size no one sees today.

note.label: The Keys Of Hell & Death: The Lake Of Fire

precepts.why:
“And what shall they do that have been before me”: what shall those souls do that have been before me? There are generations of people that were before Ezra; he’s asking, what about them? “Or we that be now”: ’cause sometimes we think that everybody on the planet now, that’s everybody. This is not everybody; there are generations before us, way before us. “Or they that shall come after us?” So Ezra said you have nations of men before us, the generation that’s currently living, and generations after us: what about those three groups?

“I will liken my judgment unto a ring: like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first.” So judgment is like a steady rotation: everybody got to get it, everybody gets it.

“Couldest thou not make those that have been made, and be now, and that are for to come, at once”, do everything at once, “that thou mightest shew thy judgment the sooner? Then answered he me, and said, The creature may not haste above the maker; neither may the world hold them at once that shall be created therein.” The angel said the planet can’t hold everybody at one time.

That’s why, when we read, he said this group I’m casting into the lake of fire, this other group I’m just going to kill y’all, but then a thousand years later, now I’m going to get this group here. Everything can’t be done at once; you can’t get them all at once. Ain’t nobody on the planet teaching this, and it’s crystal clear. The beast and the false prophet are already there waiting, so there’s a group out of every generation that he’s putting there, and when another group comes he’s going to add them to it, until all of the generations are taken care of, in that lake of fire forever.
